spans.s: सौति m. An epithet of Karṇa.
सौत्य n. The office of a charioteer, अक्षमोऽस्य सौत्येऽधिकृतः Nal.iv.9.
सौत्र (I) a. (f. त्री) 1. Relating to or having a thread; 2. belonging to or mentioned in a Sūtra.
सौत्र (II) m. 1. A Brāhmaṇa; 2. an artificial root occurring in grammatical Sūtras used only to form derivative nouns.
सौत्र (I) a. (f. त्री) 1. Relating to or having a thread; 2. belonging to or mentioned in a Sūtra.
सौत्रांतिक m. pl. Name of one of the four great schools of Buddhism.
